unassignedReview: Later-stage account, budget and commercial evidence
Final shipped-image notice inventory and redistribution review

taskOwnership.ownerRule: The first owner listed is accountable for the task record; dependent owners may contribute evidence but cannot change the contract without updating the register.
taskOwnership.evidenceRule: M0 tasks use the current candidate record. Later tasks use internal/evidence/acceptance/<milestone>/<candidate-id>/record.json and must carry the exact source, schema, lock, configuration, contract and validator digests.

scenarioOwnership.ownerRule: SC-* prefixes map to ownerRules above. A scenario with more than one milestone is recorded against the earliest required milestone and must carry later profile evidence before the later gate can pass.

verificationCommands.command: corepack pnpm run typecheck; corepack pnpm run build

statusSemantics.passRule: Only an independent reviewer and the integrator may transition a mandatory gate to PASS; a fixture or mock cannot satisfy an account-backed profile.

digestInvalidation.action: Mark the affected record STALE, retain the prior evidence, rerun the failed profile and all dependent regressions, then obtain independent rereview.
digestInvalidation.releaseRule: Any shipped-file change after an M8 candidate digest reopens 9.3 and invalidates 9.4 plus affected 9.14 evidence.
